<script>
  // Observabilidad de errores frontend (Fase 8-9 P1, ver observabilidad_errores_setup.sql).
  // Se registra ANTES que cualquier otro script (incluido el SDK de Supabase) para
  // no perderse errores tempranos; si todavía no existe un cliente listo, los junta
  // en un buffer y los manda apenas el cliente de esta página se crea más abajo.
  // Nunca incluye datos de usuario -- solo la ruta de la página y un mensaje genérico.
  window.__aurzaneErrBuf = [];
  window.__aurzaneLogErr = function(msg){
    var entry = { pagina: location.pathname, mensaje: String(msg == null ? 'Error desconocido' : msg).slice(0,300) };
    if(window.__aurzaneSb && window.__aurzaneSb.from){
      window.__aurzaneSb.from('frontend_error_log').insert(entry).then(function(){}, function(){});
    } else {
      window.__aurzaneErrBuf.push(entry);
    }
  };
  window.addEventListener('error', function(e){ window.__aurzaneLogErr(e && e.message); });
  window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', function(e){
    var r = e && e.reason;
    window.__aurzaneLogErr((r && r.message) || (r == null ? null : String(r)) || 'Promise rechazada');
  });
</script>

<style>
  /* ============================================================
     AURZANE MIND — mismos tokens que aurzane.com: claro/vainilla
     por defecto, navy/dorado como "marco" en los dos temas, paleta
     de acento compartida vía localStorage con el resto del ecosistema.
     ============================================================ */
  :root{
    --navy-950:#070a14; --navy-900:#0f1530; --navy-800:#161d42; --navy-700:#212b5c;
    --gold:#c9a24b; --gold-light:#e8cd8f; --gold-deep:#8a6a28; --gold-rgb:201,162,75;

    --bg:var(--vanilla); --surface:#fffdf9; --surface-2:#f1e8d6;

  :root[data-tema="oscuro"]{

    --text:var(--vanilla); --text-dim:var(--silver-dim); --border:rgba(199,205,214,.14);
    --accent-text:var(--gold-light);

  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}

  a{color:inherit;}
  img{max-width:100%;display:block}
  ::selection{background:rgba(var(--gold-rgb),0.35);}
  :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold-light);outline-offset:2px;}
  button{font:inherit;}
  .visually-hidden{position:absolute;left:-9999px}

  /* ===== Progreso de lectura ===== */
  .progress-bar{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:3px;width:0%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--gold-light));

  /* ===== Encabezado de mundo ===== */

  .filter-bar{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 5vw;display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;

  /* ===== Temas / exploración ===== */
  .topics-strip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:14px;}
  .topic-tile{position:relative;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;height:118px;text-decoration:none;
    border:1px solid var(--border);transition:border-color .25s,transform .25s;display:block;}

  .e-card.wide{grid-column:span 3;flex-direction:row;}

  .e-card.wide .e-body{width:62%;justify-content:center;}
  .e-card.wide .e-body h3{font-size:1.25rem;}

  .load-more-wrap{text-align:center;margin-top:32px;}

  .btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--gold);background:rgba(var(--gold-rgb),0.08);}

function listaFiltrada(){
  let lista = vistaGuardados ? ARTICULOS.filter(a => getGuardados().includes(a.slug)) : ARTICULOS.slice();

  if(filtroTipo !== 'todos') lista = lista.filter(a => tipoArticulo(a) === filtroTipo);
  if(filtroTexto.trim()){
    const q = normalizarTexto(filtroTexto);
    lista = lista.filter(a =>
      normalizarTexto(a.titulo).includes(q) ||
      normalizarTexto(a.resumen).includes(q) ||
      normalizarTexto(a.cuerpo).includes(q) ||
      (a.tags||[]).some(t => normalizarTexto(t).includes(q))
    );
  }
  if(orden === 'explorados'){
    lista = lista.slice().sort((a,b) => (b.destacado?1:0)-(a.destacado?1:0) || new Date(b.created_at)-new Date(a.created_at));
  } else {
    lista = lista.slice().sort((a,b) => new Date(b.created_at)-new Date(a.created_at));
  }
  return lista;
}

function articulosRelacionados(a){
  const otros = ARTICULOS.filter(x => x.slug !== a.slug);
  const mismaCategoria = otros.filter(x => x.categoria === a.categoria);
  const resto = otros.filter(x => x.categoria !== a.categoria)
    .sort((x,y) => new Date(y.created_at||0) - new Date(x.created_at||0));
  return mismaCategoria.concat(resto).slice(0, 3);
}

// Soporta "## " para subtítulos y "> " para citas destacadas dentro del cuerpo.
// Si el artículo no usa esta convención (como los actuales, más breves),
// el cuerpo se renderiza como párrafos normales y el índice lateral se oculta.
function renderCuerpo(cuerpo){
  const bloques = (cuerpo||'').split(/\n\s*\n/);
  const toc = [];
  let idx = 0;
  const html = bloques.map(b => {
    const t = b.trim();
    if(t.startsWith('## ')){
      idx++;
      const texto = t.slice(3).trim();
      const id = 'sec-' + idx;
      toc.push({id, texto});
      return `<h2 id="${id}">${escapeHtml(texto)}</h2>`;
    }
    if(t.startsWith('> ')){
      return `<blockquote>${escapeHtml(t.slice(2).trim())}</blockquote>`;
    }
    return `<p>${escapeHtml(t)}</p>`;
  }).join('');
  return { html, toc };
}

  cont.innerHTML = `

    </details></div>` : ''}

    const url = location.href;
    if(navigator.share){ try{ await navigator.share({title:a.titulo, url}); }catch(e){} }
    else { copiarEnlace(url, document.getElementById('btnCompartir')); }
  });
  document.getElementById('btnCopiar').addEventListener('click', () => copiarEnlace(location.href, document.getElementById('btnCopiar')));

  if(toc.length){

  } else {
    tocSide.style.display = 'none';
  }

}

function copiarEnlace(url, btn){
  const original = btn.textContent;
  const done = () => { btn.textContent = '✓ Copiado'; setTimeout(()=>{ btn.textContent = original; }, 1800); };
  if(navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText){
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(done).catch(()=>{});
  } else {
    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = url; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select();
    try{ document.execCommand('copy'); done(); }catch(e){}
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
  }
}

/* Barra de progreso de lectura + resaltado del índice activo */
window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  const view = document.getElementById('articleView');
  const bar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
  if(view.style.display === 'none'){ bar.style.width = '0%'; return; }
  const h = document.documentElement;
  const scrolled = h.scrollTop;
  const max = h.scrollHeight - h.clientHeight;
  bar.style.width = max > 0 ? Math.min(100, (scrolled/max)*100) + '%' : '0%';

  const headings = document.querySelectorAll('.article-cuerpo h2[id]');
  let activeId = null;
  headings.forEach(hd => { if(hd.getBoundingClientRect().top < 140) activeId = hd.id; });
  document.querySelectorAll('.toc-side li a').forEach(a => a.classList.toggle('active', a.dataset.id === activeId));
}, {passive:true});

function routear(){
  const hash = location.hash;
  const mArt = hash.match(/^#\/articulo\/(.+)$/);
  const mCat = hash.match(/^#categoria=([a-z-]+)$/);
  const esGuardados = hash === '#guardados';

  if(mArt){
    document.getElementById('indexView').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('articleView').style.display = 'block';
    renderArticulo(decodeURIComponent(mArt[1]));
    return;
  }

  document.getElementById('articleView').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('indexView').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width = '0%';

  vistaGuardados = esGuardados;
  document.getElementById('navGuardados').classList.toggle('active', esGuardados);
  document.getElementById('navGuias').classList.toggle('active', !esGuardados);

  if(mCat && CATEGORIAS[mCat[1]]){
    filtroCategoria = mCat[1];
  }
  if(ARTICULOS.length){ render(); }
}

document.getElementById('searchInput').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
  filtroTexto = e.target.value;

  // Observabilidad de errores frontend (Fase 8-9 P1, ver observabilidad_errores_setup.sql).
  // Se registra ANTES que cualquier otro script (incluido el SDK de Supabase) para

  window.__aurzaneErrBuf = [];

    var entry = { pagina: location.pathname, mensaje: String(msg == null ? 'Error desconocido' : msg).slice(0,300) };
    if(window.__aurzaneSb && window.__aurzaneSb.from){
      window.__aurzaneSb.from('frontend_error_log').insert(entry).then(function(){}, function(){});

      window.__aurzaneErrBuf.push(entry);

  window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', function(e){
    var r = e && e.reason;

// Sin catálogo de tipo manual todavía para NEXUS (24 artículos) — se calcula
// por heurística en tipoArticulo(). Se puede ampliar TIPO_OVERRIDE con slugs
// puntuales más adelante si se quiere afinar alguno a mano.
const TIPO_OVERRIDE = {};

let ARTICULOS = [];
let CROSS_MIND = [];
let CROSS_LIVE = [];
let filtroCategoria = 'todos';
let filtroTipo = 'todos';
let orden = 'recientes';

let visibleCount = 9;
let vistaGuardados = false;

function escapeHtml(s){
  return (s||'').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":'''}[c]));
}

function urlSegura(u){
  try{
    const parsed = new URL(u, location.href);
    return (parsed.protocol === 'http:' || parsed.protocol === 'https:') ? parsed.href : '#';
  }catch(e){
    return '#';
  }
}

function normalizarTexto(s){
  return (s||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').toLowerCase();
}

function catLabel(cat){ return CATEGORIAS[cat] || cat; }
function catImg(cat){ return CAT_IMG[cat] || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1518770660439-4636190af475?q=80&w=700&h=500&fit=crop&auto=format'; }

function tipoArticulo(a){
  if(TIPO_OVERRIDE[a.slug]) return TIPO_OVERRIDE[a.slug];
  const n = (a.fuentes||[]).length;
  if(n === 0) return 'AURZANE';
  if(n >= 3) return 'Research';
  return 'Guide';
}

function tiempoLectura(cuerpo){
  const palabras = (cuerpo||'').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  return Math.max(1, Math.round(palabras / 200));
}

function fechaCorta(iso){
  try{ return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString('es-EC', {day:'numeric', month:'short', year:'numeric'}); }
  catch(e){ return ''; }
}

const PALETAS = {
  dorado:    { nombre: "Dorado clásico", n950: "#080B17", n900: "#0F1530", n800: "#151C3D", n700: "#1E2650", gold: "#C9A24B", goldLight: "#EACF92", goldDeep: "#8A6A28" },
  esmeralda: { nombre: "Esmeralda",      n950: "#071510", n900: "#0D1F19", n800: "#132B22", n700: "#1B3A2E", gold: "#4BA97C", goldLight: "#8FE0BB", goldDeep: "#1F6B4A" },
  purpura:   { nombre: "Púrpura real",   n950: "#0E0A1A", n900: "#171029", n800: "#211640", n700: "#2E1E58", gold: "#9A7DD1", goldLight: "#C9B4EE", goldDeep: "#5B3F94" },
  grafito:   { nombre: "Grafito plata",  n950: "#0A0A0C", n900: "#131316", n800: "#1B1B20", n700: "#26262C", gold: "#B8BEC7", goldLight: "#E4E7EB", goldDeep: "#6B7078" },

};
function hexARgb(hex) {
  const h = hex.replace("#", "");
  return [parseInt(h.slice(0, 2), 16), parseInt(h.slice(2, 4), 16), parseInt(h.slice(4, 6), 16)].join(",");
}
function aplicarPaleta(clave) {
  const p = PALETAS[clave] || PALETAS.dorado;
  const raiz = document.documentElement.style;
  raiz.setProperty("--navy-950", p.n950);
  raiz.setProperty("--navy-900", p.n900);
  raiz.setProperty("--navy-800", p.n800);
  raiz.setProperty("--navy-700", p.n700);
  raiz.setProperty("--gold", p.gold);
  raiz.setProperty("--gold-light", p.goldLight);
  raiz.setProperty("--gold-deep", p.goldDeep);
  raiz.setProperty("--gold-rgb", hexARgb(p.gold));
  try { localStorage.setItem("aurzane-paleta", clave); } catch (e) {}
  document.querySelectorAll(".paleta-swatch").forEach((sw) => sw.classList.toggle("activo", sw.dataset.clave === clave));
}
(function () {
  const cont = document.getElementById("paletaSwatches");
  cont.innerHTML = Object.keys(PALETAS).map(
    (clave) => `<button class="paleta-swatch" data-clave="${clave}" style="background:${PALETAS[clave].gold}" title="${PALETAS[clave].nombre}" aria-label="${PALETAS[clave].nombre}"></button>`
  ).join("");
  cont.querySelectorAll(".paleta-swatch").forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => aplicarPaleta(btn.dataset.clave));
  });
  let guardada = "dorado";
  try { guardada = localStorage.getItem("aurzane-paleta") || "dorado"; } catch (e) {}
  aplicarPaleta(guardada);
})();

function getGuardados(){
  try{ return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('aurzane-nexus-guardados') || '[]'); }catch(e){ return []; }
}
function setGuardados(arr){
  try{ localStorage.setItem('aurzane-nexus-guardados', JSON.stringify(arr)); }catch(e){}
  actualizarContadorGuardados();
}
function toggleGuardado(slug){
  const arr = getGuardados();
  const i = arr.indexOf(slug);
  if(i === -1) arr.push(slug); else arr.splice(i,1);
  setGuardados(arr);
  return arr.includes(slug);
}
function actualizarContadorGuardados(){
  const n = getGuardados().length;
  const el = document.getElementById('savedCount');
  el.style.display = n > 0 ? 'inline-block' : 'none';

}

async function cargarArticulos(){
  const { data, error } = await sb
    .from('nexus_articulos')
    .select('slug,categoria,titulo,resumen,cuerpo,fuentes,tags,destacado,created_at')
    .order('created_at', { ascending:false });

  document.getElementById('loadState').style.display = 'none';

  if(error){
    document.getElementById('contentArea').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('featuredSection').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('topicsSection').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('exploredSection').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('researchSection').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('emptyState').style.display='block';
    document.getElementById('emptyState').innerHTML = '<p>No pudimos cargar el catálogo en este momento. Intenta de nuevo en unos minutos.</p>';
    console.error(error);
    return;
  }
  ARTICULOS = data || [];
  document.getElementById('contentArea').style.display = 'block';
  actualizarContadorGuardados();
  renderMetaMundo();
  renderFiltros();
  renderFeatured();
  renderTopics();
  renderExplored();
  renderResearch();
  render();
  cargarCrossWorld();
}

async function cargarCrossWorld(){
  try{
    const [{data:mind}, {data:live}] = await Promise.all([
      sb.from('mind_articulos').select('slug,categoria,titulo,resumen,created_at').order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(4),
      sb.from('live_articulos').select('slug,categoria,titulo,resumen,created_at').order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(4)
    ]);
    CROSS_MIND = mind || [];
    CROSS_LIVE = live || [];
    renderCrossWorld();
  }catch(e){
    document.getElementById('crossWorldSection').style.display = 'none';
  }
}

    {key:'Research', label:'Investigación', kind:'tipo'},

    if(t.key === 'divider') return '<span class="f-chip divider"></span>';

    if(t.kind === 'tipo') active = filtroTipo === t.key;

function listaFiltrada(){
  let lista = vistaGuardados ? ARTICULOS.filter(a => getGuardados().includes(a.slug)) : ARTICULOS.slice();
  if(filtroCategoria !== 'todos') lista = lista.filter(a => a.categoria === filtroCategoria);
  if(filtroTipo !== 'todos') lista = lista.filter(a => tipoArticulo(a) === filtroTipo);
  if(filtroTexto.trim()){
    const q = normalizarTexto(filtroTexto);
    lista = lista.filter(a =>
      normalizarTexto(a.titulo).includes(q) ||
      normalizarTexto(a.resumen).includes(q) ||
      normalizarTexto(a.cuerpo).includes(q) ||
      (a.tags||[]).some(t => normalizarTexto(t).includes(q))
    );
  }
  if(orden === 'explorados'){
    lista = lista.slice().sort((a,b) => (b.destacado?1:0)-(a.destacado?1:0) || new Date(b.created_at)-new Date(a.created_at));
  } else {
    lista = lista.slice().sort((a,b) => new Date(b.created_at)-new Date(a.created_at));
  }
  return lista;
}

function articulosRelacionados(a){
  const otros = ARTICULOS.filter(x => x.slug !== a.slug);
  const mismaCategoria = otros.filter(x => x.categoria === a.categoria);
  const resto = otros.filter(x => x.categoria !== a.categoria)
    .sort((x,y) => new Date(y.created_at||0) - new Date(x.created_at||0));
  return mismaCategoria.concat(resto).slice(0, 3);
}

function renderCuerpo(cuerpo){
  const bloques = (cuerpo||'').split(/\n\s*\n/);
  const toc = [];
  let idx = 0;
  const html = bloques.map(b => {
    const t = b.trim();
    if(t.startsWith('## ')){
      idx++;
      const texto = t.slice(3).trim();
      const id = 'sec-' + idx;
      toc.push({id, texto});
      return `<h2 id="${id}">${escapeHtml(texto)}</h2>`;
    }
    if(t.startsWith('> ')){
      return `<blockquote>${escapeHtml(t.slice(2).trim())}</blockquote>`;
    }
    return `<p>${escapeHtml(t)}</p>`;
  }).join('');
  return { html, toc };
}

      <ul style="list-style:none;margin-top:10px;">${toc.map(t=>`<li style="padding:5px 0;"><a href="#${t.id}" style="color:var(--silver);text-decoration:none;font-size:0.85rem;">${escapeHtml(t.texto)}</a></li>`).join('')}</ul>
    </details></div>` : ''}
    <div class="article-cuerpo">${cuerpoHtml}</div>
    ${tagsHtml ? `<div class="tags">${tagsHtml}</div>` : ''}
    <div class="fuentes">
      <h4>Fuentes</h4>
      <ol>${fuentesHtml || '<li>Fuente no especificada.</li>'}</ol>
    </div>
    ${relacionadosHtml ? `
    <div class="related-block">
      <h4>Sigue explorando en NEXUS</h4>
      <div class="related-grid">${relacionadosHtml}</div>
    </div>` : ''}
    <a class="tool-banner tool-banner-article" href="https://aurzane.com/#knowledge-hub" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
      <div><span class="tb-tag">AURZANE</span><span class="tb-title">Este artículo es parte de un ecosistema más grande — descubre las otras 4 áreas y el resto del Knowledge Hub →</span></div>
      <span class="tb-arrow">Explorar AURZANE →</span>
    </a>
  `;

  document.getElementById('btnGuardar').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const g = toggleGuardado(a.slug);
    e.target.textContent = g ? '✓ Guardado' : '☆ Guardar';
    e.target.classList.toggle('saved', g);
  });
  document.getElementById('btnCompartir').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const url = location.href;
    if(navigator.share){ try{ await navigator.share({title:a.titulo, url}); }catch(e){} }
    else { copiarEnlace(url, document.getElementById('btnCompartir')); }
  });
  document.getElementById('btnCopiar').addEventListener('click', () => copiarEnlace(location.href, document.getElementById('btnCopiar')));

  if(toc.length){
    tocSide.style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('tocList').innerHTML = toc.map(t => `<li><a href="#${t.id}" data-id="${t.id}">${escapeHtml(t.texto)}</a></li>`).join('');
  } else {
    tocSide.style.display = 'none';
  }

  window.scrollTo(0,0);
}

function copiarEnlace(url, btn){
  const original = btn.textContent;
  const done = () => { btn.textContent = '✓ Copiado'; setTimeout(()=>{ btn.textContent = original; }, 1800); };
  if(navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText){
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(done).catch(()=>{});
  } else {
    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = url; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select();
    try{ document.execCommand('copy'); done(); }catch(e){}
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
  }
}

window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  const view = document.getElementById('articleView');
  const bar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
  if(view.style.display === 'none'){ bar.style.width = '0%'; return; }
  const h = document.documentElement;
  const scrolled = h.scrollTop;
  const max = h.scrollHeight - h.clientHeight;
  bar.style.width = max > 0 ? Math.min(100, (scrolled/max)*100) + '%' : '0%';

  const headings = document.querySelectorAll('.article-cuerpo h2[id]');
  let activeId = null;
  headings.forEach(hd => { if(hd.getBoundingClientRect().top < 140) activeId = hd.id; });
  document.querySelectorAll('.toc-side li a').forEach(a => a.classList.toggle('active', a.dataset.id === activeId));
}, {passive:true});

function routear(){
  const hash = location.hash;
  const mArt = hash.match(/^#\/articulo\/(.+)$/);
  const mCat = hash.match(/^#categoria=([a-z_]+)$/);
  const esGuardados = hash === '#guardados';

  if(mArt){
    document.getElementById('indexView').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('articleView').style.display = 'block';
    renderArticulo(decodeURIComponent(mArt[1]));
    return;
  }

  document.getElementById('articleView').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('indexView').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width = '0%';

  vistaGuardados = esGuardados;
  document.getElementById('navGuardados').classList.toggle('active', esGuardados);
  document.getElementById('navArticulos').classList.toggle('active', !esGuardados);

  if(mCat && CATEGORIAS[mCat[1]]){
    filtroCategoria = mCat[1];
  }
  if(ARTICULOS.length){ render(); }
}

document.getElementById('searchInput').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
  filtroTexto = e.target.value;
  visibleCount = 9;
  render();
});

window.addEventListener('hashchange', routear);

cargarArticulos().then(routear);
</script>

      window.__aurzaneSb.from('frontend_error_log').insert(entry).then(function(){}, function(){});

      window.__aurzaneErrBuf.push(entry);

  window.addEventListener('error', function(e){ window.__aurzaneLogErr(e && e.message); });
  window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', function(e){
    var r = e && e.reason;
    window.__aurzaneLogErr((r && r.message) || (r == null ? null : String(r)) || 'Promise rechazada');
  });

    --accent-text:var(--gold-deep);
  }
  :root[data-tema="oscuro"]{
    --bg:var(--navy-950); --surface:var(--navy-900); --surface-2:var(--navy-800);
    --text:var(--vanilla); --text-dim:var(--silver-dim); --border:rgba(199,205,214,.14);
    --accent-text:var(--gold-light);
  }
  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:'Instrument Sans',sans-serif;line-height:1.65;min-height:100vh;transition:background .2s,color .2s;}
  h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-weight:500;}
  .mono{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:500;}
  a{color:inherit;}
  img{max-width:100%;display:block;}
  ::selection{background:rgba(var(--gold-rgb),0.3);}
  :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold-light);outline-offset:2px;}
  button{font:inherit;}

  .progress-bar{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:3px;width:0%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--gold-light));
    z-index:210;transition:width .1s linear;}

  /* ===== barra superior (marco navy fijo) ===== */
  .utility{background:var(--navy-950);color:var(--silver-dim);font-size:.78rem;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
  .utility .u-wrap{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 6vw;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .utility a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
  .utility a:hover{color:var(--gold-light)}
  .utility-mundos{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center}
  .utility-mundos .activo{color:var(--gold-light);font-weight:600}
  .utility-right{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center}
  #btnTema{background:none;border:none;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;font-size:.78rem;font-family:inherit;padding:2px}

  /* ===== topbar ===== */
  .topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(250,246,236,0.92);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:16px 5vw;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  :root[data-tema="oscuro"] .topbar{background:rgba(7,10,20,0.92)}
  .brand{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:0.06em;text-decoration:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
  .brand .z{color:var(--gold);}
  .brand .tag{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--text-dim);letter-spacing:0.08em;}
  .topbar-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;}
  .topbar nav{display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;}
  .topbar nav a.tlink{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.76rem;color:var(--text-dim);text-decoration:none;letter-spacing:0.03em;
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;}
  .topbar nav a.tlink:hover, .topbar nav a.tlink.active{color:var(--accent-text);}
  .saved-count{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.62rem;background:rgba(var(--gold-rgb),.18);color:var(--accent-text);
    border-radius:10px;padding:1px 6px;}
  .pill-cuenta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 13px;font-size:.78rem;text-decoration:none;color:var(--text);font-family:'Instrument Sans',sans-serif}
  .pill-cuenta:hover{border-color:var(--gold)}
  .btn-todo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--navy-950);color:var(--vanilla);border:none;
    border-radius:999px;padding:8px 14px;font-family:'Instrument Sans',sans-serif;font-weight:600;font-size:.8rem;cursor:pointer}
  .btn-todo:hover{background:var(--navy-800)}
  @media(max-width:980px){.topbar nav a.tlink span.label{display:none}}
  @media(max-width:640px){.topbar nav{gap:10px}}

  /* ===== panel "Todo LIVE" ===== */
  .todo-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(7,10,20,.55);z-index:200;display:none}
  .todo-overlay.abierto{display:block}
  .todo-panel{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;bottom:0;width:min(360px,88vw);background:var(--navy-950);color:var(--vanilla);
    z-index:201;overflow-y:auto;transform:translateX(-100%);transition:transform .25s}
  .todo-panel.abierto{transform:translateX(0)}
  .todo-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:18px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
    position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--navy-950);z-index:2}
  .todo-header .quien{font-weight:700;font-size:.98rem;font-family:'Instrument Sans',sans-serif}
  .todo-header .quien small{display:block;font-weight:400;color:var(--silver-dim);font-size:.76rem;margin-top:2px}
  .todo-cerrar{background:none;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:var(--vanilla);border-radius:8px;width:32px;height:32px;cursor:pointer;font-size:1rem}
  .todo-grupo{padding:16px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
  .todo-grupo h5{font-family:'Instrument Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--gold-light);margin:0 0 12px}
  .todo-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 0;text-decoration:none;color:var(--vanilla);font-size:.88rem;font-family:'Instrument Sans',sans-serif;background:none;border:none;width:100%;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}
  .todo-link:hover{color:var(--gold-light)}
  .todo-link .ic{width:22px;text-align:center;flex-shrink:0}
  .paleta-selector{padding:12px 0 4px}
  .paleta-label{display:block;font-size:.76rem;color:var(--silver-dim);margin-bottom:9px;font-family:'Instrument Sans',sans-serif}
  .paleta-swatches{display:flex;gap:9px}
  .paleta-swatch{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:999px;border:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;padding:0;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
  .paleta-swatch.activo{border-color:var(--vanilla)}

  /* ===== hero ===== */
  .world-header{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:8vh 6vw 4vh;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
  .world-header::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-30%;right:-10%;width:600px;height:600px;border-radius:48% 52% 60% 40%/50% 45% 55% 50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, rgba(var(--gold-rgb),0.16), rgba(var(--gold-rgb),0.04) 60%, transparent 78%);
    filter:blur(6px);pointer-events:none;z-index:0;animation:blob-move 14s ease-in-out infinite;}
  @keyframes blob-move{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1);}50%{transform:translate(-18px,14px) scale(1.04);}}
  .world-header-in{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:760px;}
  .eyebrow{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:500;color:var(--accent-text);font-size:0.72rem;letter-spacing:0.22em;text-transform:uppercase;}
  .world-header h1{font-size:clamp(2.1rem,4.8vw,3.3rem);margin:16px 0 16px;line-height:1.08;}
  .world-header h1 span{color:var(--accent-text);}
  .world-header p{color:var(--text-dim);font-size:1.04rem;max-width:58ch;}
  .world-meta-row{display:flex;gap:26px;margin-top:26px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .world-meta-row .wm{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.72rem;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .world-meta-row .wm b{color:var(--accent-text);font-size:0.95rem;display:block;font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:2px;}

  /* ===== franja de confianza (marco navy fijo) ===== */
  .trust-strip{background:var(--navy-950);padding:30px 6vw;margin-top:2vh;}
  .trust-strip-in{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:28px;}
  .trust-item h4{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-weight:500;font-size:0.92rem;color:var(--gold-light);margin-bottom:7px;}
  .trust-item p{font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--silver-dim);line-height:1.5;}
  @media(max-width:980px){.trust-strip-in{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}
  @media(max-width:640px){.trust-strip-in{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

  /* ===== accesos rápidos ===== */
  .accesos-section{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:6vh 6vw 0;}
  .accesos-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:14px;}
  .acceso-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:20px 18px;text-decoration:none;background:var(--surface);
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;transition:border-color .25s,transform .25s;
    box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05),0 8px 20px -14px rgba(0,0,0,0.16);}
  .acceso-card:hover{border-color:var(--line-accent);transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .acceso-card .ac-ic{font-size:1.4rem;}
  .acceso-card h4{font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--text);font-family:'Instrument Sans',sans-serif;font-weight:600;line-height:1.25;}
  .acceso-card p{font-size:0.74rem;color:var(--text-dim);}
  @media(max-width:980px){ .accesos-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);} }
  @media(max-width:640px){ .accesos-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);} }

  .search-wrap{max-width:680px;margin:0 auto;}
  .filter-bar{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 6vw;display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;}
  .filter-chips{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;padding-bottom:4px;}
  .f-chip{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.72rem;padding:7px 15px;border-radius:20px;white-space:nowrap;
    border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-dim);cursor:pointer;background:var(--surface);transition:all .2s;}
  .f-chip:hover{border-color:var(--line-accent);color:var(--accent-text);}
  .f-chip.active{background:var(--gold);color:var(--navy-950);border-color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;}
  .f-chip.divider{width:1px;padding:0;border:none;background:var(--border);margin:0 2px;}
  .search-box{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:24px;padding:9px 16px;min-width:220px;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .search-box svg{flex-shrink:0;opacity:0.6;}
  .search-box input{flex:1;background:none;border:none;outline:none;color:var(--text);font-family:'Instrument Sans',sans-serif;font-size:0.88rem;width:100%;}
  .search-box input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold-light);}
  .search-box input::placeholder{color:var(--text-dim);}

  .wrap{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:5vh 6vw 10vh;}
  .section-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:20px;margin-bottom:26px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .section-head .sh-eyebrow{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.68rem;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-text);display:block;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .section-head h2{font-size:clamp(1.4rem,2.6vw,1.9rem);}
  .section-head .sh-link{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.76rem;color:var(--accent-text);text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;}
  .section-head .sh-link:hover{text-decoration:underline;}
  .result-count{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.72rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:20px;}

  .tipo-tag{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.09em;text-transform:uppercase;
    padding:3px 9px;border-radius:3px;display:inline-block;}
  .tipo-tag.Research{background:#5f74c9;color:#fff;}
  .tipo-tag.Guide{background:var(--gold);color:var(--navy-950);}
  .tipo-tag.Analysis{background:#3f8fa6;color:#fff;}
  .tipo-tag.AURZANE{background:var(--gold-deep);color:#fff;}

  .featured-comp{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr;gap:22px;}
  .f-main{position:relative;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;min-height:420px;align-items:flex-end;
    cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;display:flex;border:1px solid var(--border);
    box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05),0 14px 32px -18px rgba(0,0,0,0.22);}
  .f-main img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .5s ease;background:linear-gradient(150deg,var(--navy-800),var(--navy-900) 75%);}
  .f-main:hover img{transform:scale(1.045);}
  .f-main-overlay{position:relative;z-index:1;width:100%;padding:34px 30px;background:linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(7,10,20,0.96) 0%, rgba(7,10,20,0.55) 55%, rgba(7,10,20,0.05) 100%);}
  .f-main-tags{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px;align-items:center;}
  .f-main-overlay h3{font-size:clamp(1.4rem,2.6vw,2rem);line-height:1.18;margin-bottom:12px;color:#fff;}
  .f-main-overlay p{color:var(--silver);font-size:0.92rem;max-width:52ch;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .f-main-meta{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.72rem;color:var(--silver-dim);display:flex;gap:16px;}
  .f-side{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px;}
  .fs-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:18px;text-decoration:none;display:flex;gap:14px;
    flex:1;transition:border-color .25s,transform .25s;background:var(--surface);
    box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05),0 8px 20px -14px rgba(0,0,0,0.16);}
  .fs-card:hover{border-color:var(--line-accent);transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .fs-card img{width:84px;height:84px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--surface-2);}
  .fs-card-body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-width:0;}
  .fs-card-body h4{font-size:0.92rem;line-height:1.3;color:var(--text);font-weight:500;font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;}
  .fs-card-body .fs-meta{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.64rem;color:var(--text-dim);}

  .topics-strip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:14px;}
  .topic-tile{position:relative;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;height:118px;text-decoration:none;
    border:1px solid var(--border);transition:border-color .25s,transform .25s;display:block;background:var(--surface-2);}
  .topic-tile:hover{border-color:var(--line-accent);transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .topic-tile img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;opacity:0.7;transition:opacity .25s,transform .4s;}
  .topic-tile:hover img{opacity:0.85;transform:scale(1.06);}
  .topic-tile-label{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:12px;
    background:linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(7,10,20,0.9), transparent 65%);}
  .topic-tile-label span{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.72rem;color:#fff;font-weight:500;}
  .topic-tile.active{border-color:var(--gold);}

  .editorial-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;}
  .e-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:border-color .25s,transform .25s;background:var(--surface);
    box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05),0 10px 26px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.18);}
  .e-card:hover{border-color:var(--line-accent);transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .e-card .e-img{width:100%;height:170px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;background:var(--surface-2);}
  .e-card .e-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .5s ease;}
  .e-card:hover .e-img img{transform:scale(1.06);}
  .e-card .e-tags{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;display:flex;gap:6px;}
  .e-body{padding:18px 20px 20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;flex:1;}
  .e-body h3{font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.32;}
  .e-body p{color:var(--text-dim);font-size:0.85rem;flex:1;}
  .e-foot{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.66rem;color:var(--text-dim);
    display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);}
  .e-card.wide{grid-column:span 3;flex-direction:row;}
  .e-card.wide .e-img{width:38%;height:auto;}
  .e-card.wide .e-body{width:62%;justify-content:center;}
  .e-card.wide .e-body h3{font-size:1.25rem;}

  .load-more-wrap{text-align:center;margin-top:32px;}
  .btn-outline{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--accent-text);background:none;
    border:1px solid var(--line-accent);border-radius:24px;padding:11px 28px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;}
  .btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--gold);background:rgba(var(--gold-rgb),0.08);}

  .explored-strip{display:flex;gap:16px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:12px;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;}
  .ex-card{flex:0 0 260px;scroll-snap-align:start;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;
    text-decoration:none;display:block;transition:border-color .25s,transform .25s;background:var(--surface);
    box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05),0 8px 20px -14px rgba(0,0,0,0.16);}
  .ex-card:hover{border-color:var(--line-accent);transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .ex-card .ex-img{height:140px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;background:var(--surface-2);}
  .ex-card .ex-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
  .ex-card .ex-num{position:absolute;bottom:8px;left:10px;font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:1.6rem;color:#fff;
    text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);}
  .ex-body{padding:14px 16px;}
  .ex-body h4{font-size:0.9rem;line-height:1.3;margin-top:6px;}

  .research-band{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--border);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;}
  .research-stat{background:var(--surface);padding:26px 20px;text-align:center;}
  .research-stat .rs-num{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:2.1rem;color:var(--accent-text);}
  .research-stat .rs-label{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-top:6px;}
  .research-sources{margin-top:18px;font-size:0.86rem;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .research-sources b{color:var(--accent-text);font-weight:500;}
  .research-sources a{color:var(--accent-text);text-decoration:none;}
  .research-sources a:hover{text-decoration:underline;}
  @media(max-width:980px){.research-band{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}

  .tool-banner{border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:10px;padding:28px 30px;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(var(--gold-rgb),0.1), var(--surface));
    display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;text-decoration:none;transition:border-color .2s;}
  .tool-banner:hover{border-color:var(--gold);}
  .tool-banner .tb-tag{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.64rem;color:var(--accent-text);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;display:block;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .tool-banner .tb-title{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--text);max-width:60ch;}
  .tool-banner .tb-arrow{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;color:var(--accent-text);font-size:0.85rem;white-space:nowrap;
    border:1px solid var(--line-accent);border-radius:20px;padding:10px 20px;}

  .cross-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:16px;}
  .cw-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:18px;text-decoration:none;display:block;
    transition:border-color .25s,transform .25s;background:var(--surface);}
  .cw-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .cw-card .cw-world{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.62rem;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
    padding:3px 9px;border-radius:3px;display:inline-block;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .cw-card.w-mind{border-color:rgba(201,162,75,0.3);}
  .cw-card.w-mind:hover{border-color:#c9a24b;}
  .cw-card.w-mind .cw-world{background:rgba(201,162,75,0.16);color:var(--gold-deep);}
  .cw-card.w-nexus{border-color:rgba(95,116,201,0.3);}
  .cw-card.w-nexus:hover{border-color:#5f74c9;}
  .cw-card.w-nexus .cw-world{background:rgba(95,116,201,0.16);color:#5f74c9;}
  .cw-card h5{font-size:0.94rem;line-height:1.3;color:var(--text);font-weight:500;font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;}

  .empty-state, .load-state{max-width:520px;margin:12vh auto;text-align:center;padding:0 20px;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .spinner{width:28px;height:28px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-top-color:var(--gold);border-radius:50%;

  const h = hex.replace("#", "");
  return [parseInt(h.slice(0, 2), 16), parseInt(h.slice(2, 4), 16), parseInt(h.slice(4, 6), 16)].join(",");
}
function aplicarPaleta(clave) {
  const p = PALETAS[clave] || PALETAS.dorado;
  const raiz = document.documentElement.style;
  raiz.setProperty("--navy-950", p.n950);
  raiz.setProperty("--navy-900", p.n900);
  raiz.setProperty("--navy-800", p.n800);
  raiz.setProperty("--navy-700", p.n700);
  raiz.setProperty("--gold", p.gold);
  raiz.setProperty("--gold-light", p.goldLight);
  raiz.setProperty("--gold-deep", p.goldDeep);
  raiz.setProperty("--gold-rgb", hexARgb(p.gold));
  try { localStorage.setItem("aurzane-paleta", clave); } catch (e) {}
  document.querySelectorAll(".paleta-swatch").forEach((sw) => sw.classList.toggle("activo", sw.dataset.clave === clave));
}
(function () {
  const cont = document.getElementById("paletaSwatches");
  cont.innerHTML = Object.keys(PALETAS).map(
    (clave) => `<button class="paleta-swatch" data-clave="${clave}" style="background:${PALETAS[clave].gold}" title="${PALETAS[clave].nombre}" aria-label="${PALETAS[clave].nombre}"></button>`
  ).join("");
  cont.querySelectorAll(".paleta-swatch").forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => aplicarPaleta(btn.dataset.clave));
  });
  let guardada = "dorado";
  try { guardada = localStorage.getItem("aurzane-paleta") || "dorado"; } catch (e) {}
  aplicarPaleta(guardada);
})();

// Sin catálogo de tipo manual todavía para LIVE (12 artículos) — se calcula
// por heurística en tipoArticulo(). Se puede ampliar TIPO_OVERRIDE con slugs
// puntuales más adelante si se quiere afinar alguno a mano.
const TIPO_OVERRIDE = {};

let ARTICULOS = [];
let CROSS_MIND = [];
let CROSS_NEXUS = [];
let filtroCategoria = 'todos';
let filtroTipo = 'todos';
let orden = 'recientes';
let filtroTexto = '';
let visibleCount = 9;
let vistaGuardados = false;

function escapeHtml(s){
  return (s||'').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":'''}[c]));
}

function urlSegura(u){
  try{
    const parsed = new URL(u, location.href);
    return (parsed.protocol === 'http:' || parsed.protocol === 'https:') ? parsed.href : '#';
  }catch(e){
    return '#';
  }
}

function normalizarTexto(s){
  return (s||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, '').toLowerCase();
}

function catLabel(cat){ return CATEGORIAS[cat] || cat; }
function catImg(cat){ return CAT_IMG[cat] || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1500534623283-312aade485b7?q=80&w=700&h=500&fit=crop&auto=format'; }

function tipoArticulo(a){
  if(TIPO_OVERRIDE[a.slug]) return TIPO_OVERRIDE[a.slug];
  const n = (a.fuentes||[]).length;
  if(n === 0) return 'AURZANE';
  if(n >= 3) return 'Research';
  return 'Guide';
}

function tiempoLectura(cuerpo){
  const palabras = (cuerpo||'').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  return Math.max(1, Math.round(palabras / 200));
}

function fechaCorta(iso){
  try{ return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString('es-EC', {day:'numeric', month:'short', year:'numeric'}); }
  catch(e){ return ''; }
}

function getGuardados(){
  try{ return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('aurzane-live-guardados') || '[]'); }catch(e){ return []; }
}
function setGuardados(arr){
  try{ localStorage.setItem('aurzane-live-guardados', JSON.stringify(arr)); }catch(e){}
  actualizarContadorGuardados();
}
function toggleGuardado(slug){
  const arr = getGuardados();
  const i = arr.indexOf(slug);
  if(i === -1) arr.push(slug); else arr.splice(i,1);
  setGuardados(arr);
  return arr.includes(slug);
}
function actualizarContadorGuardados(){
  const n = getGuardados().length;
  const el = document.getElementById('savedCount');
  el.style.display = n > 0 ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
  el.textContent = n;
}

async function cargarArticulos(){
  const { data, error } = await sb
    .from('live_articulos')
    .select('slug,categoria,titulo,resumen,cuerpo,fuentes,tags,destacado,created_at')
    .order('created_at', { ascending:false });

  document.getElementById('loadState').style.display = 'none';

  if(error){
    document.getElementById('contentArea').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('featuredSection').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('topicsSection').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('exploredSection').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('researchSection').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('emptyState').style.display='block';
    document.getElementById('emptyState').innerHTML = '<p>No pudimos cargar el catálogo en este momento. Intenta de nuevo en unos minutos.</p>';
    console.error(error);
    return;
  }
  ARTICULOS = data || [];
  document.getElementById('contentArea').style.display = 'block';
  actualizarContadorGuardados();
  renderMetaMundo();
  renderFiltros();
  renderFeatured();
  renderTopics();
  renderExplored();
  renderResearch();
  render();
  cargarCrossWorld();
}

async function cargarCrossWorld(){
  try{
    const [{data:mind}, {data:nexus}] = await Promise.all([
      sb.from('mind_articulos').select('slug,categoria,titulo,resumen,created_at').order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(4),
      sb.from('nexus_articulos').select('slug,categoria,titulo,resumen,created_at').order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(4)
    ]);
    CROSS_MIND = mind || [];
    CROSS_NEXUS = nexus || [];
    renderCrossWorld();
  }catch(e){
    document.getElementById('crossWorldSection').style.display = 'none';
  }
}

    <div class="wm"><b>${totalFuentes}</b>fuentes citadas</div>

function renderFiltros(){
  const chipsEl = document.getElementById('filterChips');
  const tipos = [
    {key:'todos', label:'Todos', kind:'tipo'},
    {key:'recientes', label:'Más recientes', kind:'orden'},
    {key:'explorados', label:'Más explorados', kind:'orden'},
    {key:'divider'},
    {key:'Guide', label:'Guías', kind:'tipo'},
    {key:'Research', label:'Investigación', kind:'tipo'},
    {key:'Analysis', label:'Análisis', kind:'tipo'}
  ];
  chipsEl.innerHTML = tipos.map(t => {
    if(t.key === 'divider') return '<span class="f-chip divider"></span>';
    let active = false;
    if(t.kind === 'orden') active = orden === t.key;
    if(t.kind === 'tipo') active = filtroTipo === t.key;
    return `<button class="f-chip ${active?'active':''}" data-key="${t.key}" data-kind="${t.kind}">${t.label}</button>`;
  }).join('');
  chipsEl.querySelectorAll('.f-chip[data-key]').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if(btn.dataset.kind === 'orden'){ orden = btn.dataset.key; }
      else { filtroTipo = btn.dataset.key; }
      vistaGuardados = false;
      visibleCount = 9;
      renderFiltros();
      render();
    });
  });
}

function listaFiltrada(){
  let lista = vistaGuardados ? ARTICULOS.filter(a => getGuardados().includes(a.slug)) : ARTICULOS.slice();
  if(filtroCategoria !== 'todos') lista = lista.filter(a => a.categoria === filtroCategoria);
  if(filtroTipo !== 'todos') lista = lista.filter(a => tipoArticulo(a) === filtroTipo);
  if(filtroTexto.trim()){
    const q = normalizarTexto(filtroTexto);
    lista = lista.filter(a =>
      normalizarTexto(a.titulo).includes(q) ||
      normalizarTexto(a.resumen).includes(q) ||
      normalizarTexto(a.cuerpo).includes(q) ||
      (a.tags||[]).some(t => normalizarTexto(t).includes(q))
    );
  }
  if(orden === 'explorados'){
    lista = lista.slice().sort((a,b) => (b.destacado?1:0)-(a.destacado?1:0) || new Date(b.created_at)-new Date(a.created_at));
  } else {
    lista = lista.slice().sort((a,b) => new Date(b.created_at)-new Date(a.created_at));
  }
  return lista;
}

  const lista = listaFiltrada();

function articulosRelacionados(a){
  const otros = ARTICULOS.filter(x => x.slug !== a.slug);
  const mismaCategoria = otros.filter(x => x.categoria === a.categoria);
  const resto = otros.filter(x => x.categoria !== a.categoria)
    .sort((x,y) => new Date(y.created_at||0) - new Date(x.created_at||0));
  return mismaCategoria.concat(resto).slice(0, 3);
}

function renderCuerpo(cuerpo){
  const bloques = (cuerpo||'').split(/\n\s*\n/);
  const toc = [];
  let idx = 0;
  const html = bloques.map(b => {
    const t = b.trim();
    if(t.startsWith('## ')){
      idx++;
      const texto = t.slice(3).trim();
      const id = 'sec-' + idx;
      toc.push({id, texto});
      return `<h2 id="${id}">${escapeHtml(texto)}</h2>`;
    }
    if(t.startsWith('> ')){
      return `<blockquote>${escapeHtml(t.slice(2).trim())}</blockquote>`;
    }
    return `<p>${escapeHtml(t)}</p>`;
  }).join('');
  return { html, toc };
}

    ${toc.length ? `<div class="toc-mobile"><details><summary class="mono" style="cursor:pointer;color:var(--accent-text);font-size:0.78rem;">Índice del artículo</summary>
      <ul style="list-style:none;margin-top:10px;">${toc.map(t=>`<li style="padding:5px 0;"><a href="#${t.id}" style="color:var(--text-dim);text-decoration:none;font-size:0.85rem;">${escapeHtml(t.texto)}</a></li>`).join('')}</ul>
    </details></div>` : ''}
    <div class="article-cuerpo">${cuerpoHtml}</div>
    ${tagsHtml ? `<div class="tags">${tagsHtml}</div>` : ''}
    <div class="fuentes">
      <h4>Fuentes</h4>
      <ol>${fuentesHtml || '<li>Fuente no especificada.</li>'}</ol>
    </div>
    ${relacionadosHtml ? `
    <div class="related-block">
      <h4>Sigue explorando en LIVE</h4>
      <div class="related-grid">${relacionadosHtml}</div>
    </div>` : ''}
    <a class="tool-banner tool-banner-article" href="https://aurzane.com/#knowledge-hub" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
      <div><span class="tb-tag">AURZANE</span><span class="tb-title">Este artículo es parte de un ecosistema más grande — descubre las otras 4 áreas y el resto del Knowledge Hub →</span></div>
      <span class="tb-arrow">Explorar AURZANE →</span>
    </a>
  `;

  document.getElementById('btnGuardar').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const g = toggleGuardado(a.slug);
    e.target.textContent = g ? '✓ Guardado' : '☆ Guardar';
    e.target.classList.toggle('saved', g);
  });
  document.getElementById('btnCompartir').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const url = location.href;
    if(navigator.share){ try{ await navigator.share({title:a.titulo, url}); }catch(e){} }
    else { copiarEnlace(url, document.getElementById('btnCompartir')); }
  });
  document.getElementById('btnCopiar').addEventListener('click', () => copiarEnlace(location.href, document.getElementById('btnCopiar')));

  if(toc.length){
    tocSide.style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('tocList').innerHTML = toc.map(t => `<li><a href="#${t.id}" data-id="${t.id}">${escapeHtml(t.texto)}</a></li>`).join('');
  } else {
    tocSide.style.display = 'none';
  }

  window.scrollTo(0,0);
}

function copiarEnlace(url, btn){
  const original = btn.textContent;
  const done = () => { btn.textContent = '✓ Copiado'; setTimeout(()=>{ btn.textContent = original; }, 1800); };
  if(navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText){
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(done).catch(()=>{});
  } else {
    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = url; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select();
    try{ document.execCommand('copy'); done(); }catch(e){}
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
  }
}

window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  const view = document.getElementById('articleView');
  const bar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
  if(view.style.display === 'none'){ bar.style.width = '0%'; return; }
  const h = document.documentElement;
  const scrolled = h.scrollTop;
  const max = h.scrollHeight - h.clientHeight;
  bar.style.width = max > 0 ? Math.min(100, (scrolled/max)*100) + '%' : '0%';

  const headings = document.querySelectorAll('.article-cuerpo h2[id]');
  let activeId = null;
  headings.forEach(hd => { if(hd.getBoundingClientRect().top < 140) activeId = hd.id; });
  document.querySelectorAll('.toc-side li a').forEach(a => a.classList.toggle('active', a.dataset.id === activeId));
}, {passive:true});

function routear(){
  const hash = location.hash;
  const mArt = hash.match(/^#\/articulo\/(.+)$/);
  const mCat = hash.match(/^#categoria=([a-z_]+)$/);
  const esGuardados = hash === '#guardados';

  if(mArt){
    document.getElementById('indexView').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('articleView').style.display = 'block';
    renderArticulo(decodeURIComponent(mArt[1]));
    return;
  }

  document.getElementById('articleView').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('indexView').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width = '0%';

  vistaGuardados = esGuardados;
  document.getElementById('navGuardados').classList.toggle('active', esGuardados);
  document.getElementById('navArticulos').classList.toggle('active', !esGuardados);

  if(mCat && CATEGORIAS[mCat[1]]){
    filtroCategoria = mCat[1];
  }
  if(ARTICULOS.length){ render(); }
}

document.getElementById('searchInput').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
  filtroTexto = e.target.value;
  visibleCount = 9;
  render();
});

window.addEventListener('hashchange', routear);

cargarArticulos().then(routear);
</script>

  .btn-curso:hover{background:var(--navy-800);border-color:var(--gold);}
  .btn-curso:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold-deep);outline-offset:3px;}
  :root[data-tema="oscuro"] .btn-curso{background:var(--gold);color:var(--navy-950);border-color:var(--gold);}
  :root[data-tema="oscuro"] .btn-curso:hover{background:var(--gold-light);border-color:var(--gold-light);}
  :root[data-tema="oscuro"] .btn-curso:focus-visible{outline-color:var(--gold-light);}
  @media(max-width:980px){
    .curso-dest{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .curso-dest-body{padding:24px 22px 26px;}
  }
  @media(max-width:420px){
    .cd-datos{gap:4px 18px;}
    .cd-datos li b{font-size:1.15rem;}
  }

  /* ===== Filtros + búsqueda ===== */
  .filter-bar{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 6vw;display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;}
  .filter-chips{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;padding-bottom:4px;}
  .f-chip{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.72rem;padding:7px 15px;border-radius:20px;white-space:nowrap;
    border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-dim);cursor:pointer;background:var(--surface);transition:all .2s;}
  .f-chip:hover{border-color:var(--line-accent);color:var(--accent-text);}
  .f-chip.active{background:var(--gold);color:var(--navy-950);border-color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;}
  .f-chip.divider{width:1px;padding:0;border:none;background:var(--border);margin:0 2px;}
  .search-box{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:24px;padding:9px 16px;min-width:220px;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .search-box svg{flex-shrink:0;opacity:0.6;}
  .search-box input{flex:1;background:none;border:none;outline:none;color:var(--text);font-family:'Instrument Sans',sans-serif;font-size:0.88rem;width:100%;}
  .search-box input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold-light);}
  .search-box input::placeholder{color:var(--text-dim);}

  .wrap{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:5vh 6vw 10vh;}
  .section-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:20px;margin-bottom:26px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .section-head .sh-eyebrow{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.68rem;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-text);display:block;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .section-head h2{font-size:clamp(1.4rem,2.6vw,1.9rem);}
  .result-count{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.72rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:20px;}

  /* ===== Tags de tipo ===== */
  .tipo-tag{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.09em;text-transform:uppercase;
    padding:3px 9px;border-radius:3px;display:inline-block;}
  .tipo-tag.Research{background:#5f74c9;color:#fff;}
  .tipo-tag.Guide{background:var(--gold);color:var(--navy-950);}
  .tipo-tag.Analysis{background:#c06a3f;color:#fff;}
  .tipo-tag.AURZANE{background:var(--gold-deep);color:#fff;}

  /* ===== Composición destacada ===== */
  .featured-comp{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr;gap:22px;}
  .f-main{position:relative;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;min-height:420px;align-items:flex-end;
    cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;display:flex;border:1px solid var(--border);
    box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05),0 14px 32px -18px rgba(0,0,0,0.22);}
  .f-main img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .5s ease;background:linear-gradient(150deg,var(--navy-800),var(--navy-900) 75%);}
  .f-main:hover img{transform:scale(1.045);}
  .f-main-overlay{position:relative;z-index:1;width:100%;padding:34px 30px;background:linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(7,10,20,0.96) 0%, rgba(7,10,20,0.55) 55%, rgba(7,10,20,0.05) 100%);}
  .f-main-tags{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px;align-items:center;}
  .f-main-overlay h3{font-size:clamp(1.4rem,2.6vw,2rem);line-height:1.18;margin-bottom:12px;color:#fff;}
  .f-main-overlay p{color:var(--silver);font-size:0.92rem;max-width:52ch;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .f-main-meta{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.72rem;color:var(--silver-dim);display:flex;gap:16px;}
  .f-side{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px;}
  .fs-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:18px;text-decoration:none;display:flex;gap:14px;
    flex:1;transition:border-color .25s,transform .25s;background:var(--surface);
    box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05),0 8px 20px -14px rgba(0,0,0,0.16);}
  .fs-card:hover{border-color:var(--line-accent);transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .fs-card img{width:84px;height:84px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--surface-2);}
  .fs-card-body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-width:0;}
  .fs-card-body h4{font-size:0.92rem;line-height:1.3;color:var(--text);font-weight:500;font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;}
  .fs-card-body .fs-meta{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.64rem;color:var(--text-dim);}

  /* ===== Temas / exploración ===== */
  .topics-strip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:14px;}
  .topic-tile{position:relative;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;height:118px;text-decoration:none;
    border:1px solid var(--border);transition:border-color .25s,transform .25s;display:block;background:var(--surface-2);}
  .topic-tile:hover{border-color:var(--line-accent);transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .topic-tile img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;opacity:0.7;transition:opacity .25s,transform .4s;}
  .topic-tile:hover img{opacity:0.85;transform:scale(1.06);}
  .topic-tile-label{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:12px;
    background:linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(7,10,20,0.9), transparent 65%);}
  .topic-tile-label span{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.72rem;color:#fff;font-weight:500;}
  .topic-tile.active{border-color:var(--gold);}

  /* ===== Grid editorial (guías recientes) ===== */
  .editorial-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;}
  .e-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:border-color .25s,transform .25s;background:var(--surface);
    box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05),0 10px 26px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.18);}
  .e-card:hover{border-color:var(--line-accent);transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .e-card .e-img{width:100%;height:170px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;background:var(--surface-2);}
  .e-card .e-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .5s ease;}
  .e-card:hover .e-img img{transform:scale(1.06);}
  .e-card .e-tags{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;display:flex;gap:6px;}
  .e-body{padding:18px 20px 20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;flex:1;}
  .e-body h3{font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.32;}
  .e-body p{color:var(--text-dim);font-size:0.85rem;flex:1;}
  .e-foot{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.66rem;color:var(--text-dim);
    display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);}
  .e-card.wide{grid-column:span 3;flex-direction:row;}
  .e-card.wide .e-img{width:38%;height:auto;}
  .e-card.wide .e-body{width:62%;justify-content:center;}
  .e-card.wide .e-body h3{font-size:1.25rem;}

  .load-more-wrap{text-align:center;margin-top:32px;}
  .btn-outline{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--accent-text);background:none;
    border:1px solid var(--line-accent);border-radius:24px;padding:11px 28px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;}
  .btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--gold);background:rgba(var(--gold-rgb),0.08);}

  /* ===== Más explorado (tira horizontal) ===== */
  .explored-strip{display:flex;gap:16px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:12px;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;}
  .ex-card{flex:0 0 260px;scroll-snap-align:start;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;
    text-decoration:none;display:block;transition:border-color .25s,transform .25s;background:var(--surface);
    box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05),0 8px 20px -14px rgba(0,0,0,0.16);}
  .ex-card:hover{border-color:var(--line-accent);transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .ex-card .ex-img{height:140px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;background:var(--surface-2);}
  .ex-card .ex-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
  .ex-card .ex-num{position:absolute;bottom:8px;left:10px;font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:1.6rem;color:#fff;
    text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);}
  .ex-body{padding:14px 16px;}
  .ex-body h4{font-size:0.9rem;line-height:1.3;margin-top:6px;}

  /* ===== Research / recursos ===== */
  .research-band{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--border);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;}
  .research-stat{background:var(--surface);padding:26px 20px;text-align:center;}
  .research-stat .rs-num{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:2.1rem;color:var(--accent-text);}
  .research-stat .rs-label{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-top:6px;}
  .research-sources{margin-top:18px;font-size:0.86rem;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .research-sources b{color:var(--accent-text);font-weight:500;}
  .research-sources a{color:var(--accent-text);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;}
  .research-sources a:hover{text-decoration:underline;}
  @media(max-width:980px){.research-band{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}

  .philosophy-band{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:40px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:64px;}
  .philosophy-band img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--border);}
  .philosophy-text p{color:var(--text-dim);font-size:0.98rem;margin-bottom:16px;max-width:56ch;}
  .philosophy-text p:last-child{margin-bottom:0;}

  .roadmap-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--border);border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:64px;}
  .roadmap-item{background:var(--surface);padding:26px 24px;}
  .roadmap-item .ri-num{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:1.6rem;color:var(--accent-text);margin-bottom:10px;display:block;}
  .roadmap-item h4{font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .roadmap-item p{font-size:0.84rem;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .roadmap-item .ri-status{display:inline-block;margin-top:12px;font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.62rem;
    text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:3px;background:rgba(var(--gold-rgb),0.16);color:var(--accent-text);}

  /* ===== Banner de herramienta ===== */
  .tool-banner{border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:10px;padding:28px 30px;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(var(--gold-rgb),0.1), rgba(var(--gold-rgb),0.02));
    display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;text-decoration:none;transition:border-color .2s;}
  .tool-banner:hover{border-color:var(--gold);}
  .tool-banner .tb-tag{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.64rem;color:var(--accent-text);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;display:block;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .tool-banner .tb-title{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--text);max-width:60ch;}
  .tool-banner .tb-arrow{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;color:var(--accent-text);font-size:0.85rem;white-space:nowrap;
    border:1px solid var(--line-accent);border-radius:20px;padding:10px 20px;}
  .tool-banner-article{margin-top:26px;}

  /* ===== Cross-world ===== */
  .cross-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:16px;}
  .cw-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:18px;text-decoration:none;display:block;
    transition:border-color .25s,transform .25s;background:var(--surface);}
  .cw-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .cw-card .cw-world{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.62rem;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
    padding:3px 9px;border-radius:3px;display:inline-block;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .cw-card.w-mind{border-color:rgba(201,162,75,0.3);}
  .cw-card.w-mind:hover{border-color:#c9a24b;}
  .cw-card.w-mind .cw-world{background:rgba(201,162,75,0.16);color:var(--gold-deep);}
  .cw-card.w-nexus{border-color:rgba(95,116,201,0.3);}
  .cw-card.w-nexus:hover{border-color:#5f74c9;}
  .cw-card.w-nexus .cw-world{background:rgba(95,116,201,0.16);color:#5f74c9;}
  .cw-card h5{font-size:0.94rem;line-height:1.3;color:var(--text);font-weight:500;font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;}

  .empty-state, .load-state{max-width:520px;margin:12vh auto;text-align:center;padding:0 20px;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .spinner{width:28px;height:28px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-top-color:var(--gold);border-radius:50%;
    animation:spin 0.8s linear infinite;margin:0 auto 20px;}
  @keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg);}}

  /* ===== Vista de guía ===== */
  .article-shell{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:4vh 6vw 12vh;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 220px;gap:56px;align-items:start;}
  .article-wrap{max-width:720px;}
  .back-link{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--text-dim);text-decoration:none;
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:8px;cursor:pointer;background:none;border:none;}
  .back-link:hover{color:var(--accent-text);}
  .article-wrap .cat-badge{margin:18px 0 14px;display:inline-block;}
  .article-wrap h1{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,3.8vw,2.7rem);margin-bottom:18px;line-height:1.14;}
  .article-resumen{font-size:1.08rem;color:var(--accent-text);margin-bottom:22px;font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-weight:400;font-style:italic;line-height:1.5;}
  .article-meta-row{display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;
    font-size:0.74rem;color:var(--text-dim);padding-bottom:22px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);margin-bottom:26px;}
  .article-meta-row .am-author{color:var(--text);}
  .article-hero-img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/8;object-fit:cover;border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:30px;background:var(--surface-2);}
  .action-row{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .action-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.72rem;
    color:var(--text-dim);background:none;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;padding:8px 15px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;}
  .action-btn:hover{border-color:var(--gold-light);color:var(--accent-text);}
  .action-btn.saved{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--accent-text);background:rgba(var(--gold-rgb),0.1);}
  .toc-mobile{display:none;}
  .cat-badge{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.66rem;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--accent-text);align-self:flex-start;padding:4px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line-accent);border-radius:12px;}
  .article-cuerpo{font-size:1.02rem;}
  .article-cuerpo h2{font-size:1.4rem;margin:34px 0 14px;color:var(--text);}
  .article-cuerpo h3{font-size:1.15rem;margin:26px 0 10px;color:var(--accent-text);}
  .article-cuerpo p{color:var(--text);margin-bottom:18px;max-width:65ch;}
  .article-cuerpo blockquote{border-left:3px solid var(--gold);margin:28px 0;padding:4px 0 4px 22px;
    font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--accent-text);max-width:60ch;}
  .tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:26px 0;}
  .tag{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--text-dim);border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:12px;padding:4px 12px;}
  .fuentes{margin-top:40px;padding:22px 24px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line-accent);}
  .fuentes h4{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.72rem;letter-spacing:0.15em;text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--accent-text);margin-bottom:14px;}
  .fuentes ol{list-style:none;counter-reset:fu;padding:0;}
  .fuentes li{font-size:0.87rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:12px;padding-left:26px;position:relative;counter-increment:fu;}
  .fuentes li::before{content:counter(fu);position:absolute;left:0;top:0;font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;
    font-size:0.7rem;color:var(--accent-text);border:1px solid var(--line-accent);border-radius:50%;width:18px;height:18px;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
  .fuentes a{color:var(--accent-text);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;}
  .fuentes a:hover{text-decoration:underline;}

  .related-block{margin-top:44px;padding-top:28px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-accent);}
  .related-block h4{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.72rem;letter-spacing:0.15em;text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--accent-text);margin-bottom:16px;}
  .related-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:14px;}
  .related-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:16px;text-decoration:none;display:block;
    transition:border-color .25s, transform .25s;background:var(--surface);}
  .related-card:hover{border-color:var(--line-accent);transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .related-card .cat-badge{margin-bottom:8px;}
  .related-card h5{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-weight:500;font-size:0.92rem;line-height:1.3;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:4px;}
  .related-card span.rc-meta{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.64rem;color:var(--text-dim);}

  /* Índice lateral (TOC) */
  .toc-side{position:sticky;top:90px;}
  .toc-side .toc-label{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:0.64rem;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:12px;display:block;}
  .toc-side ul{list-style:none;border-left:1px solid var(--border);}
  .toc-side li a{display:block;font-size:0.82rem;color:var(--text-dim);text-decoration:none;padding:6px 0 6px 16px;
    border-left:2px solid transparent;margin-left:-1px;transition:color .2s,border-color .2s;}
  .toc-side li a:hover{color:var(--text);}
  .toc-side li a.active{color:var(--accent-text);border-color:var(--gold);}

  /* ===== footer ===== */
  footer.pie-learn{background:var(--navy-950);color:var(--silver-dim);padding:52px 6vw 26px;margin-top:20px;}
  footer.pie-learn .pie-grid{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr repeat(3,1fr);gap:28px;}
  footer.pie-learn .pie-brand{font-family:'Bodoni Moda',serif;font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--vanilla);margin-bottom:10px;}
  footer.pie-learn .pie-brand span{color:var(--gold);}
  footer.pie-learn .pie-desc{font-size:0.84rem;max-width:280px;color:var(--silver-dim);margin:0;}
  footer.pie-learn h5{color:var(--gold-light);font-size:0.78rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;margin-bottom:12px;font-family:'Instrument Sans',sans-serif;font-weight:600;}
  footer.pie-learn .pie-col a{display:block;color:var(--silver-dim);text-decoration:none;font-size:0.86rem;padding:4px 0;}
  footer.pie-learn .pie-col a:hover{color:var(--gold-light);}
  footer.pie-learn .pie-legal{max-width:1200px;margin:34px auto 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;
    border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);padding-top:18px;font-size:0.78rem;}
  footer.pie-learn .pie-legal a{color:var(--silver-dim);text-decoration:none;}
  footer.pie-learn .pie-legal a:hover{color:var(--gold-light);}
  @media(max-width:900px){footer.pie-learn .pie-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}

  @media(max-width:980px){
    .featured-comp{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .f-main{min-height:320px;}

function escapeHtml(s){
  return (s||'').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":'''}[c]));
}

function urlSegura(u){
  try{
    const parsed = new URL(u, location.href);
    return (parsed.protocol === 'http:' || parsed.protocol === 'https:') ? parsed.href : '#';
  }catch(e){
    return '#';
  }
}

function normalizarTexto(s){
  return (s||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, '').toLowerCase();
}

function catLabel(cat){ return CATEGORIAS[cat] || cat; }
function catImg(cat){ return CAT_IMG[cat] || CAT_IMG['aprendizaje-adultos']; }

function tipoArticulo(a){
  if(TIPO_OVERRIDE[a.slug]) return TIPO_OVERRIDE[a.slug];
  const n = (a.fuentes||[]).length;
  if(n === 0) return 'AURZANE';
  if(n >= 3) return 'Research';
  return 'Guide';
}

function tiempoLectura(cuerpo){
  const palabras = (cuerpo||'').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  return Math.max(1, Math.round(palabras / 200));
}

function fechaCorta(iso){
  try{ return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString('es-EC', {day:'numeric', month:'short', year:'numeric'}); }
  catch(e){ return ''; }
}

function getGuardados(){

}
function setGuardados(arr){
  try{ localStorage.setItem('aurzane-learn-guardados', JSON.stringify(arr)); }catch(e){}

}
function toggleGuardado(slug){
  const arr = getGuardados();
  const i = arr.indexOf(slug);
  if(i === -1) arr.push(slug); else arr.splice(i,1);
  setGuardados(arr);
  return arr.includes(slug);
}

async function cargarArticulos(){
  const { data, error } = await sb
    .from('learn_articulos')
    .select('slug,categoria,titulo,resumen,cuerpo,fuentes,tags,destacado,created_at')
    .order('created_at', { ascending:false });

  document.getElementById('loadState').style.display = 'none';

  if(error){
    document.getElementById('contentArea').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('featuredSection').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('topicsSection').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('exploredSection').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('researchSection').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('emptyState').style.display='block';
    document.getElementById('emptyState').innerHTML = '<p>No pudimos cargar el catálogo en este momento. Intenta de nuevo en unos minutos.</p>';
    console.error(error);
    return;
  }
  ARTICULOS = data || [];

  actualizarContadorGuardados();
  renderMetaMundo();
  renderFiltros();
  renderFeatured();
  renderTopics();

async function cargarCrossWorld(){
  try{
    const [{data:mind}, {data:nexus}] = await Promise.all([
      sb.from('mind_articulos').select('slug,categoria,titulo,resumen,created_at').order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(4),

    ]);

function listaFiltrada(){
  let lista = vistaGuardados ? ARTICULOS.filter(a => getGuardados().includes(a.slug)) : ARTICULOS.slice();
  if(filtroCategoria !== 'todos') lista = lista.filter(a => a.categoria === filtroCategoria);
  if(filtroTipo !== 'todos') lista = lista.filter(a => tipoArticulo(a) === filtroTipo);
  if(filtroTexto.trim()){
    const q = normalizarTexto(filtroTexto);
    lista = lista.filter(a =>
      normalizarTexto(a.titulo).includes(q) ||
      normalizarTexto(a.resumen).includes(q) ||
      normalizarTexto(a.cuerpo).includes(q) ||
      (a.tags||[]).some(t => normalizarTexto(t).includes(q))
    );
  }
  if(orden === 'explorados'){
    lista = lista.slice().sort((a,b) => (b.destacado?1:0)-(a.destacado?1:0) || new Date(b.created_at)-new Date(a.created_at));
  } else {
    lista = lista.slice().sort((a,b) => new Date(b.created_at)-new Date(a.created_at));
  }
  return lista;
}

function articulosRelacionados(a){
  const otros = ARTICULOS.filter(x => x.slug !== a.slug);
  const mismaCategoria = otros.filter(x => x.categoria === a.categoria);
  const resto = otros.filter(x => x.categoria !== a.categoria)
    .sort((x,y) => new Date(y.created_at||0) - new Date(x.created_at||0));
  return mismaCategoria.concat(resto).slice(0, 3);
}

// Soporta "## " para subtítulos y "> " para citas destacadas dentro del cuerpo.
// Si el artículo no usa esta convención, el cuerpo se renderiza como párrafos normales
// y el índice lateral se oculta.
function renderCuerpo(cuerpo){
  const bloques = (cuerpo||'').split(/\n\s*\n/);
  const toc = [];
  let idx = 0;
  const html = bloques.map(b => {
    const t = b.trim();
    if(t.startsWith('## ')){
      idx++;
      const texto = t.slice(3).trim();
      const id = 'sec-' + idx;
      toc.push({id, texto});
      return `<h2 id="${id}">${escapeHtml(texto)}</h2>`;
    }
    if(t.startsWith('> ')){
      return `<blockquote>${escapeHtml(t.slice(2).trim())}</blockquote>`;
    }
    return `<p>${escapeHtml(t)}</p>`;
  }).join('');
  return { html, toc };
}

    <div class="related-block">
      <h4>Sigue explorando en LEARN</h4>
